Sprout height can show a different aspect of cohort development from basal area.
We'll review the treatment, annual-increment, and year-10 height displays
together to find the smallest set that communicates that evidence for redwood
and tanoak. The starting figures are `fig-sprout-ht-inc-treat`,
`fig-sprout-ht-inc-year`, and `fig-sprout-ht-yr-10` in the thesis Results.
The chosen figures and captions should distinguish treatment patterns from
changes through time; remaining material can be considered for the supplement.
